origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): toolConfig mode VALIDATED, which leaves the choice between a call and words to the model (the Gemini API reference) and so is the default choice of a relay, not a forced call. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
